>>C<< OIL SEAL INSTALLATION
1. Apply gear oil (Hypoid gear oil SAE 75W-90 or 75W-85W 
conforming to API classification GL-4).
2. Using special tool MD998325 <F5M42> or MD998800 
<F5M51>, press fit the oil seal into the transaxle case.
